remarks: Step into the comfort and warmth of this bright and inviting 2-bedroom, 1.5-bath townhouse located in the desirable Upper Springdale neighborhood. With a spacious open floor plan, this home is perfect for both everyday living and entertaining. Beautiful hardwood floors flow throughout, and the fully equipped kitchen features sleek stainless steel appliances- ideal for anyone who loves to cook. The living room opens to a private balcony, offering a great spot to relax or enjoy your morning coffee. Upstairs, you'll find two generously sized bedrooms with oversized closets that provide ample storage. An in-unit washer and dryer make laundry day a breeze, and the attached one-car garage adds extra convenience. There's also plenty of parking available for both residents and guests. Hot water is included in common charges. Conveniently located near shopping centers, Metro-North, the Merritt Parkway, and downtown Stamford, this home puts everything within easy reach.
